findings.claim: 'publish posts nothing and exits 0, in every mode' was unclear, since publish is itself one of the action's modes.

verdict.text: This was a narrow round on f1, and f1 is fixed.
The no-report sentence now reads "publish posts nothing and exits 0, whether it would have posted an issue or a pull request comment", which says what the old "in every mode" meant.
The fix changed nothing else in the Correction, and the accepted text above it is still byte-identical to main.
Gates: `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree gave "stamp green: 35fdc14f54d3f4c7e33c9b1301bfed54e122df9250e32e1ac459a9c7052fcc4f".
lint, format, tests and integration passed, and so did eval rows r1, r2, r3, r5, r6, r8, r9, r10 (prek run --all-files), r11 and r12.
I read the ADR 0057 diff against main (`git diff --cached main`).
The only change in the no-report sentence is the new wording.
The fix did not touch any text r5 or r11 check ("exits 0", "both", "no report"), and both still pass.
r9 re-sign: the new command writes `git show main:<adr>` to a temp file, takes that many bytes from the head of the worktree file, compares them with `cmp -s`, and then checks `^status: stable`.
That fails when the accepted text changes at all, which is what fails_when says.
Line 174 of the ADR now names the two outputs publish could have posted (an issue or a pull request comment) and no longer says "every mode".
